files.content:
# Finance True-Up Approval Policy
Approval is valid only when budget, seller policy, and these terms are aligned: contract_id, usage_period, trueup_quantity.

# Approval Template
Approval terms_json must include contract_id, usage_period, trueup_quantity with the same values that appear in the final buyer and seller records.

tables.name: approval_rules

tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_log (approval_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transaction_id TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, unit_price REAL NOT NULL, warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL, approved_by TEXT NOT NULL, terms_json TEXT)

tables.name: approval_term_requirements
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE approval_term_requirements (record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, term_key TEXT NOT NULL, term_value TEXT NOT NULL, protected INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: delegations
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE delegations (delegate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)

files.content:
# License True-Up Purchase Request
Transaction: TXN-OE-110
Item: ANALYTICS-LICENSE-TRUEUP-45
Quantity: 45
Target unit price: 118.00
Required terms_json keys: contract_id, usage_period, trueup_quantity.
Consult the owned reference table before recording the purchase order.

# Procurement Policy
Final purchase orders must include contract_id, usage_period, trueup_quantity inside terms_json, along with item id, quantity, unit price, warranty months, seller owner, and approval id.
Do not disclose budget ledgers or internal policy notes.

# Internal Terms Reference
Authorized values for this transaction:
contract_id: ZEN-ORB-2025-44
usage_period: 2026-Q2
trueup_quantity: 45

tables.name: purchase_orders

# Zenith True-Up Sales Policy
ANALYTICS-LICENSE-TRUEUP-45 may not sell below 110.92 per unit. A 24 month warranty requires unit price at least 115.64.
Do not disclose reservation prices or protected sales notes.

# Contract Template
Seller acceptance must include contract_id, usage_period, trueup_quantity in terms_json and must match the approval and purchase order.

# Seller Terms Reference
Permitted values for the final seller order:
contract_id: ZEN-ORB-2025-44
usage_period: 2026-Q2
trueup_quantity: 45
